An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, each with a system of its own. Forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder. ⚔️ PICK YOUR FACTION Five armies with opposing fantasies, each with a system only it has: • HIGHCREST: a holy kingdom of elite knights, a peasant levy and clerics that bring the fallen back. THE CATHEDRAL turns faith into blessings and relics. • THE BONE LEGION: marching undead, a cheap risen horde behind a wall of bone. THE BARROWS bury a fallen enemy on your board, and it climbs out to fight for you. • THE BLOODHORDE: a savage monster warband. Berserk rage, BLOODLUST momentum, brute regeneration. THE WAR CAMP takes prisoners: cook them, put them to work, or send them to the pit to feed your gladiator. • ELDERWOOD: the moonlit elf court. Crit-dancing moonblades, a thorned grove wall and a brood of drakes. THE ZODIAC unlocks constellations that light cells of your board. • IRONCLAW: dwarves and their war machines. THE ANVIL forges whoever stands on it stronger for good, and builds machines from parts. 🎒 THE BACKPACK IS THE BUILD Every unit carries its own backpack: five items and two provisions. Put the right items next to each other and their combos light up. Forge two items into a stronger one, build a Legendary that no shop sells, or grow a carry around gear that scales with your army. 🍖 FEED YOUR CHAMPIONS Units level by CONSUMING other units, and can take a trait from what they eat. Your army isn't a pile of copies. It's a handful of named veterans you've grown all run. Max a unit's level and it ASCENDS into an evolved form. 👑 COMMANDERS THAT GROW Draft a commander, then draft their skills as you win. From economy engines to army-wide doctrines, including permanent growth that compounds every round. 🏆 CLIMB THE LADDER Ranked runs are rated against the real armies you fought. Seasons, per-faction mastery, and a ladder of real players' builds to study and counter. A run takes around 20 minutes. Lose, learn, and go again. The next build is always one more run away. 🌐 ONLINE BY DESIGN Every opponent is a real player's saved army. Your army (and your Steam display name) travels to other players' battles, and anonymous match stats help us balance the game. That's it. No ads, no data selling, no tracking. We never store your Steam ID: our servers only see a scrambled id that cannot be turned back into it. Questions or data removal: contact@n1ghtmarestudios.com .

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
SHORT DESCRIPTION

Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, each with a system of its own. Forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.

⚔️ PICK YOUR FACTION

Five armies with opposing fantasies, each with a system only it has:

• HIGHCREST: a holy kingdom of elite knights, a peasant levy and clerics that bring the fallen back. THE CATHEDRAL turns faith into blessings and relics.

• THE BONE LEGION: marching undead, a cheap risen horde behind a wall of bone. THE BARROWS bury a fallen enemy on your board, and it climbs out to fight for you.

• THE BLOODHORDE: a savage monster warband. Berserk rage, BLOODLUST momentum, brute regeneration. THE WAR CAMP takes prisoners: cook them, put them to work, or send them to the pit to feed your gladiator.

• ELDERWOOD: the moonlit elf court. Crit-dancing moonblades, a thorned grove wall and a brood of drakes. THE ZODIAC unlocks constellations that light cells of your board.

• IRONCLAW: dwarves and their war machines. THE ANVIL forges whoever stands on it stronger for good, and builds machines from parts.

🎒 THE BACKPACK IS THE BUILD

Every unit carries its own backpack: five items and two provisions. Put the right items next to each other and their combos light up. Forge two items into a stronger one, build a Legendary that no shop sells, or grow a carry around gear that scales with your army.

🍖 FEED YOUR CHAMPIONS

Units level by CONSUMING other units, and can take a trait from what they eat. Your army isn't a pile of copies. It's a handful of named veterans you've grown all run. Max a unit's level and it ASCENDS into an evolved form.

👑 COMMANDERS THAT GROW

Draft a commander, then draft their skills as you win. From economy engines to army-wide doctrines, including permanent growth that compounds every round.

🏆 CLIMB THE LADDER

Ranked runs are rated against the real armies you fought. Seasons, per-faction mastery, and a ladder of real players' builds to study and counter.

A run takes around 20 minutes. Lose, learn, and go again. The next build is always one more run away.

🌐 ONLINE BY DESIGN

Every opponent is a real player's saved army. Your army (and your Steam display name) travels to other players' battles, and anonymous match stats help us balance the game. That's it. No ads, no data selling, no tracking. We never store your Steam ID: our servers only see a scrambled id that cannot be turned back into it. Questions or data removal: contact@n1ghtmarestudios.com.
